name: Ritter des Schwarzen Grals
mini: Trench-Crusade-Figur aus der Black-Grail-Warband von Chris (17.10.): türkise Schuppenrüstung, rot-kupferne Schulterplatten, Helm mit Stachelkamm, blaues zerfetztes Cape, Speer mit Gabelklinge, Sichelklingen an den Unterarmen.

karte.name: Ritter des Schwarzen Grals
karte.weapons:
Gralsspeer | Nahkampf | A2 | DS(1), Stoß
Sichelklingen | Nahkampf | A2 | Reißend
karte.look: a plague knight in teal scaled armour with rust-red pauldrons, spiked helmet crest, tattered blue cloak and a forked bloody spear

prompt:
Create one image: a dramatic still frame from a big-budget live-action dark fantasy war film, the kind of shot that ends up on the poster. Photorealistic and cinematic: anamorphic lens, shallow depth of field, strong directional light with deep shadows, volumetric haze, fine film grain, a muted, slightly desaturated colour grade.

This is a real scene, not a model: the knight is a full-size living warrior, played by a tall actor in a heavy practical costume with real weight, real corroded metal, wet mud and torn fabric. Never a miniature, figurine, action figure, toy or painted model.

Reference: the attached photo shows my hand-painted tabletop miniature. Use it only as the design reference. Keep the design, colours and distinctive details recognisable (spear with forked blade, hook blades on the wrists, spiked helmet crest, tattered cloak), but give him realistic human anatomy and scale instead of the miniature's stylised proportions, and real materials instead of plastic and paint. Do not show the base, the table or the room from the photo.

Subject: a knight of the Black Grail, a plague knight from a war-torn trench world. Corroded teal-green scaled armour over a black undersuit, rust-red pauldrons and breastplate, a dark steel helmet with a long spiked crest at the front, a moth-eaten deep blue cloak, curved hook blades on both wrists, a long black spear with a forked rust-red blade.

The moment: dusk in no man's land. He strides out of the smoke between shell craters, spear lowered for the next thrust, cloak whipping in the wind, fine rain and ash in the air. He has just turned his helmeted head towards the camera, as if he has spotted his next victim. Blood runs down the spear blade and drips into the mud.

Camera and light: low camera close to the ground, slightly wide (35mm), the knight towering over the viewer. Cold grey-blue ambient light, a hard warm rim light from behind outlining his silhouette and the edge of the cloak, his face hidden in the dark of the helmet.

Glowing accent: exactly one, a distant red signal flare far behind him, out of focus, whose red light catches the wet blood on the spear blade. Nothing else in the image glows.

Background: dark and out of focus: churned mud, splintered wooden stakes, coils of rusted barbed wire, drifting smoke. No buildings, towers, moons, ships, floating objects or second figures.

Composition: landscape 3:2 (printed as a 15 x 10 cm postcard). The knight on the right half, helmet and spear blade in the upper half. The left half stays dark and calm because the card's stat panel covers it.

Not wanted: miniature, figurine, action figure, toy, tabletop diorama, macro or tilt-shift photography, plastic or painted-model look, a static figure simply standing in a landscape. Also no digital painting, illustration, concept art, trading-card art, visible brush strokes, over-sharpened detail, oversaturated colours, fire or light effects all over the frame. No text, lettering, numbers, logos, card frame, border or user interface.
